DETAIL_OFFICIAL_WARNING: This is an official pack. Any manual changes will be overwritten during the next library synchronization.
DEVICES_EMPTY_HINT: Plug in a Lunii and its pack list will be saved here automatically.
DEVICES_NO_PACKS: No packs recorded on this device.
STORY_SUBTITLE: Compose your own story: title, covers, chapters, audio and images — the app will build a playable Lunii pack.
FINALIZE_TITLE: Ready to create your story pack
FINALIZE_TEXT: The app will assemble your story into a playable Lunii STUdio archive and add it to your library. This can take a moment for long stories.
DETAILS_SUBTITLE: Provide the foundational metadata for your new story pack.
BULK_SUBTITLE: Upload multiple audio files at once. Each file automatically becomes a new chapter in your story, pre-filled with a title, a title audio and a chapter image.
BULK_BROWSE_HINT: or browse — MP3, WAV, OGG up to 50 MB each
BULK_EMPTY: No files yet — drop or browse audio files to stage chapters.
CHAPTERS_SUBTITLE: Add chapters to your story. Each chapter has a title, a title audio (TTS or upload), a narration audio, and an image (icon or custom upload).
SETTINGS_LIBRARY_HINT: Absolute path to the folder containing your pack files
SETTINGS_MACOS_HELP: How to get the absolute path on macOS:
SETTINGS_MACOS_STEP1: In Finder, hold <kbd>⌥ Option</kbd> and right-click the folder → "Copy <name> as Pathname"
SETTINGS_MACOS_STEP2: Or drag the folder from Finder into a Terminal window
SETTINGS_TARGET_HINT: Preferred format when no device is plugged
SETTINGS_DB_HINT: Leave empty to use the default: {{path}}
SETTINGS_DB_WHERE_TEXT: Studio stores its non-official packs database in ~/.studio/db/ (file unofficial.json), created automatically on first launch. If you moved it, enter the path to the unofficial.json file above.
SETTINGS_TTS_PROVIDER_HINT: Provider used to generate story title audio. Free fallback requires no API key.
SETTINGS_TTS_LANG_HINT: Language of the generated audio (used by the free fallback)
SETTINGS_TTS_VOICE_HINT: Voice used for the generated audio
SETTINGS_TTS_FALLBACK: Default voices (live list unavailable: your API key may lack the voices_read permission)
SETTINGS_LIBRARY_WARNING: Changing the library path will clear the database and trigger a full re-sync.
SETTINGS_DB_SAVE_HINT: Save to apply the new DB path
SETTINGS_OPENAI_HINT: Your own OpenAI key, stored locally in the settings file
SETTINGS_ELEVENLABS_HINT: Your own ElevenLabs key, stored locally in the settings file
DIALOG_DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete {{title}}?
DIALOG_DELETE_WARNING: This action cannot be undone. The pack files will remain on disk.
DIALOG_COPY_TEXT: This pack {{title}} is an official Lunii story pack.
DIALOG_COPY_WARNING: Copying official packs may violate copyright. Are you sure you want to proceed?
